course.title: Surveying
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: To find the elevation of the top of the minar of KUET mosque, observations were (15) made from two stations P and R, 50 m apart. The horizontal angle measured at P between R and the top of the minar was 60º45' and that measured at R between the top of the minar and P station was 72º30'. The angle of elevation of the top of the minar was measured to be 20º17' at R and that was 20º48' at P. Stadia readings on B.M. when the instrument was at P = 2.969 m and that with the instrument at R = 3.073 m. Calculate the elevation of the minar of KUET mosque if that of B.M. was 420 m.

topics: Reconnaissance survey; Linear measurements; Traverse survey; Plane table survey; Levelling & contouring; Calculation of areas and volumes; Tachometry: Introduction, principles and problems on tachometry; Astronomical surveying: Definition, instruments, astronomical corrections, systems of time; Introduction of terrestrial photography, aerial photography, reading of photo mosaic, scale Project surveying; Errors in surveying; remote sensing; Introduction and application of global positioning system (GPS) and geographical information system (GIS), House setting.
_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
classification_notes: প্রশ্নটিতে উচ্চতা নির্ণয়, স্টেডিয়া পদ্ধতি এবং ভূমি পরিমাপের মূল নীতির প্রয়োগ করা হয়েছে যা 'Levelling & contouring' ও 'Tachometry'-এর অন্তর্ভুক্ত।
verification_notes: প্রশ্নটি স্টেডিয়া পদ্ধতিতে উচ্চতা নির্ণয় করে যা Levelling এবং Tachometry-এর সরাসরি অংশ।
